description: Source code for Kineto profiler shim in PyTorch, managing profiling activities, trace preparation, and metadata handling with conditional compilation for Kineto support.

classes.name: TraceWrapper
classes.description: Manages a CPU trace buffer, allowing adding activities, transferring, and conditional compilation based on Kineto support.

classes.name: ActivityTraceWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a trace object, providing save functionality and boolean conversion.

classes.name: ExperimentalConfigWrapper
classes.description: Handles processing of experimental profiling configuration options for Kineto.

methods.name: kineto_ids
methods.description: Returns device and resource identifiers if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: addMetadata
methods.description: Adds metadata to an activity if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: TraceWrapper::TraceWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing CPU trace buffer if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: TraceWrapper::addCPUActivity
methods.description: Adds a CPU activity to the trace buffer if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: TraceWrapper::transferCpuTrace
methods.description: Transfers the CPU trace buffer if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: TraceWrapper::operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the trace buffer exists.

methods.name: ActivityTraceWrapper::ActivityTraceWrapper
methods.description: Constructor wrapping a trace object.

methods.name: ActivityTraceWrapper::operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the trace object exists.

methods.name: ActivityTraceWrapper::save
methods.description: Saves the trace to a file if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: ExperimentalConfigWrapper::assertValid
methods.description: Validates the experimental config.

methods.name: ExperimentalConfigWrapper::prepareTraceWithExperimentalOptions
methods.description: Prepares trace with experimental options if Kineto is enabled.

methods.name: collectivesProfilerExists
methods.description: Checks if collectives profiler is available.

methods.name: setTraceID
methods.description: Generates trace ID configuration string.

methods.name: appendCustomConfig
methods.description: Appends custom profiler configuration to existing config string.

methods.name: prepareTrace
methods.description: Prepares profiling trace with given activities and config.

methods.name: toggleCollectionDynamic
methods.description: Enables or disables dynamic collection.

methods.name: startTrace
methods.description: Starts profiling trace.

methods.name: stopTrace
methods.description: Stops profiling trace and returns trace wrapper.

methods.name: pushCorrelationId
methods.description: Pushes a correlation ID.

methods.name: pushUserCorrelationId
methods.description: Pushes a user correlation ID.

methods.name: popCorrelationId
methods.description: Pops a correlation ID.

methods.name: popUserCorrelationId
methods.description: Pops a user correlation ID.

methods.name: recordThreadInfo
methods.description: Records thread information.

methods.name: logInvariantViolation
methods.description: Logs an invariant violation if profiler is initialized.

methods.name: deviceTypeFromActivity
methods.description: Maps activity type to device type.

methods.name: addMetadataJson
methods.description: Adds metadata in JSON format if profiler is initialized.

methods.name: profilerStep
methods.description: Advances the profiler step if initialized.
